items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: I just got a call... for this job... Joe Hisaishi Music from the Studio Ghibli Films... I did one a few years ago in Carnegie Hall. And this is three concerts at Madison Square Garden... we’ll be honking it out there

ctx.x: All right well that’s a good way to wrap this up. What’s your next gig? You had a Dixieland thing, what’s the next thing for you?

Well I just got a call, I mean an email for this job, it’s in Madison Square Garden. It’s three concerts with the American Symphony, and let’s see if I could — Joe Hisaishi Music from the Studio Ghibli Films. It’s anime. And this guy is a composer and conductor and pianist. Very good. And it’s a lot of fun to do. I did one a few years ago in Carnegie Hall. And this is three concerts at Madison Square Garden in July, what is it, the 11th, 12th and 13th. And that’s like 16,000 people in that place. And so we’ll be…
How do they amplify — were you playing upright bass?
